reason: Freeze exact HOLDOUT support/promotion rules before any HOLDOUT access.

confirmatory_gate.eligibility: selection_class must equal CONFIRMATORY_ELIGIBLE; SHADOW_ONLY_NO_FDR can never promote.
confirmatory_gate.primary_loss_improvement: baseline minus challenger mean squared loss must be > 0 on the frozen HOLDOUT complete-case row universe.
confirmatory_gate.block_bootstrap: equal-event moving-block 95% percentile interval lower bound must be > 0 using the TRAIN-frozen block length.
confirmatory_gate.leave_event_out: all finite leave-one-event-out mean loss improvements must be > 0.
confirmatory_gate.leave_market_out: all finite leave-one-market-out mean loss improvements must be > 0.
confirmatory_gate.leave_family_out: when at least two election families are represented, all finite leave-one-family-out mean loss improvements must be > 0.
confirmatory_gate.high_activity_removal: mean loss improvement after removal of markets at or above the HOLDOUT row-count 90th percentile must be > 0 when rows remain.
confirmatory_gate.capture_falsification: where amendment-012 capture models are supported, capture-only loss minus selected-plus-capture loss must be > 0; otherwise label capture-confounded.
confirmatory_gate.alternate_freshness: where raw_capture_bin_age_s is available and the <=300s subset has at least 10 markets and 2 event windows, its mean loss improvement must be > 0.
confirmatory_gate.continuity: primary labels must have zero reconstructed cross-segment transitions by construction.
